reviews.title: Great app thanks!!
reviews.text: I honestly had no idea how much money I was leaving on the table until I tried ClaimHunt.  I’d always see headlines about random settlements and payouts, get a bit of FOMO,  and then do nothing because I didn’t have the time or patience to dig through all the legal details. This app made the whole thing feel simple for the first time, just normal questions instead of legal jargon, and a clear list of settlements that might actually apply to me.  It feels like someone is quietly watching the boring legal stuff for me and nudging me when there’s money I could be missing out on. Even if you’re just curious whether you might be owed something, it’s a huge time saver and really helps with that FOMO feeling

reviews.title: it’s 🔥🔥
reviews.text:
My aunt told me about this app after she found a settlement she qualified for, so I figured I’d give it a try too. I wasn’t expecting much, but I ended up finding a couple of cases that were actually relevant to me. It was much easier than trying to search online by myself l(I would not do it this way)).

I like that evrethigg is organized in one place and written in a way that’s easy to understand. The reminders are also a nice touch because I’m terrible at keeping track of deadlines. 

Even if only one claim ends up paying out, it’s still money I probably would’ve never known about. Overall, it’s a really useful app and I’m glad my aunt mentioned it to me

reviews.title: Easiest way to keep track settlements!
reviews.text: Most settlement websites, feel outdated and confusing so I usually end up giving up. This app makes it so much easier to browse different class action lawsuits, quickly see which ones might apply to me and keep everything organized. My favorite feature is a tracker… It saves the cases I’m interested in so I don’t have to keep a bunch of tabs open or dig through old emails to remember what I already checked.🥳

reviews.title: Pretty useful app
reviews.text: I honestly downloaded this just out of curiosity, and I was kind of shocked that I actually qualified for a few settlements. The app is super easy to use and way less confusing than trying to figure everything out on a bunch of legal websites. I also like that you can follow the cases you’re interested in. I already found a claim I would’ve had no idea about otherwise.

reviews.title: appreciate it
reviews.text:
saw ClaimHunt on TikTok and thought it was one of those “too good to be true” apps, but im actually impressed. Downloaded it out of curiosity and ended up finding real settlements i qualified for. The app makes the whole  process super easy and understandable

What I like its notifications about deadlines are really valuable because i probably would’ve forgotten to submit several claims otherwise..

reviews.title: not worth it
reviews.text: just downloaded this app and was excited! asked me a few questions then said i’ve been missing out on all this money but to continue you have to buy for a subscription. i paid $20 for the year and told myself id be worth it as ill make the money back. after going through ALL the settlements available i cant even fill out one. the one i could wouldn’t work. all the other ones i qualify are pop up but i cant submit a claim yet. maybe one day hopefully during this year i paid for it’ll make me my money back 😬

reviews.title: Yeeeap
reviews.text:
i first heard about this app on TV show, they were talking about how people miss out on money from settlements just because they never check, and i suddenly realized that’s definitely me

i downloaded the app right after and was surprised how simple it is…no legal deep dive, just a quick way to see what might apply to you. it feels like a shortcut for smth i know i’d never bother to research on my own

reviews.title: Don’t buy
reviews.text:
Do yourself a favor and don’t download this app.  When it says that the claims don’t need proof that is not true all of them have worked on it needs some sort of proof.

And it doesn’t take you to the external sites to look up your claim numbers so then you have to end up going and looking them up on your own anyway.
